name: Gyan Mudra
benefits: Improves concentration, sharpens memory, reduces stress, and cures insomnia.
steps: Sit in a comfortable yoga posture like Padmasana or Sukhasana.
Touch the tip of your index finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep the other three fingers straight, relaxed, and parallel to each other.
Place your hands on your knees with the palms facing upwards.

name: Chin Mudra
benefits: Enhances focus, connects consciousness, calms the mind, and relieves depression.
steps: Sit upright and place your hands on your thighs.
Touch the tip of your index finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep other three fingers straight but point them downwards toward the earth.
Close your eyes and focus on your breath.

name: Dhyana Mudra
benefits: Brings deep concentration, balances right and left brain hemispheres, and brings inner peace.
steps: Sit in Padmasana or Sukhasana.
Place your right hand on top of your left hand, palms facing up, in your lap.
Touch the tips of your thumbs together, forming a triangle shape.
Keep hands relaxed and rest them close to the abdomen.

name: Bhairava Mudra
benefits: Unifies the mind, balances internal energies, and aligns spiritual focus.
steps: Sit comfortably with your spine erect.
Place your right hand on top of your left hand in your lap, both palms facing upwards.
Keep thumbs relaxed without touching.
Focus your mind on the root chakra.

name: Anjali Mudra
benefits: Promotes respect, connects brain hemispheres, and relieves stress.
steps: Bring your palms together in front of your heart center.
Ensure fingers are pointing straight up, thumbs resting gently on the breastbone.
Press the outer edges of the palms slightly together.
Bow your head slightly to seal the gesture.

name: Shambhavi Mudra
benefits: Awakens the Ajna (third eye) chakra, increases mental control, and reduces anxiety.
steps: Sit in a meditative pose with hands in Gyan Mudra on knees.
Close your eyes, then open them slightly and look upward.
Focus both eyes on the center between your eyebrows (Bhrumadhya).
Do not strain your eyes. Relax if you feel pressure.

name: Kalesvara Mudra
translation: Gesture of the Lord of Time
benefits: Clears addictive behaviors, sharpens memory, and calms emotional outbursts.
steps: Place the tips of your middle fingers together, pointing straight up.
Fold other fingers (index, ring, pinky) so their second joints touch.
Touch the tips of your thumbs together, pointing down towards your chest.
Breathe slowly and deeply.

name: Lotus Mudra (Padma)
benefits: Opens the heart chakra, cultivates love and compassion, and dispels loneliness.
steps: Bring the heels of your palms together near your heart.
Touch the tips of your pinky fingers and thumbs together.
Spread your index, middle, and ring fingers wide apart like a blooming lotus.
Inhale deeply, visualizing purity.

name: Yoni Mudra
benefits: Detaches from the outer world, balances nervous system, and cultivates female energy.
steps: Clasp your fingers together, palms facing you.
Extend your index fingers straight down, touching at the tips.
Extend your thumbs straight up, touching at the tips.
Interlock other fingers inside the palms.

name: Abhaya Mudra
benefits: Dispels fear, brings emotional security, and invokes peace and divine protection.
steps: Raise your right hand to shoulder height, elbow bent.
Turn your palm outward, facing forward, fingers pointing straight up.
Rest your left hand flat on your left lap or knee, palm facing up.
Breathe steadily, embodying confidence.

name: Hakini Mudra
benefits: Improves memory, integrates right/left brain hemispheres, and boosts brain power.
steps: Bring your hands in front of your chest.
Touch the fingertips of your right hand to the corresponding fingertips of the left hand.
Keep palms apart, forming an open hollow sphere between your hands.
Place your tongue against the roof of your mouth as you inhale.

name: Adho Mukha Mudra
benefits: Calms overactive minds, promotes deep grounding, and aids in restful sleep.
steps: Place the backs of your hands together in front of your chest.
Make sure the backs of the fingers are touching, pointing downwards.
Rest your thumbs in the center, touching at the sides.
Relax your shoulders and breathe slowly.

name: Vayu Mudra
benefits: Relieves joint pain, arthritis, bloating, and excessive gas in the stomach.
steps: Fold your index finger down to touch the base of your thumb.
Press the index finger down gently with your thumb.
Keep the other three fingers extended straight and relaxed.
Rest your hands on your knees, palms facing up.
duration: 30-45 mins daily (or during joint pain attacks)

name: Shunya Mudra
benefits: Cures earaches, relieves tinnitus, thyroid issues, and throat problems.
steps: Fold your middle finger down to the base of your thumb.
Press the middle finger down gently with the thumb.
Keep the other three fingers straight.
Practice this on both hands simultaneously.
duration: 30-40 mins daily or until earache subsides

name: Varuna Mudra
benefits: Hydrates dry skin, purifies blood, prevents wrinkles, and cures skin infections.
steps: Touch the tip of your little finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep other three fingers straight and relaxed.
Do not press the pinky finger hard, keep the touch light.
Sit comfortably and practice with both hands.

name: Linga Mudra
benefits: Generates internal body heat, cures common cold, cough, asthma, and burns fat.
steps: Interlock all fingers of both hands, keeping palms pressed together.
Keep the left thumb pointing straight upwards.
Encircle the upright left thumb with the index finger and thumb of the right hand.
Keep your hands held near the chest.
duration: 15-20 mins daily (avoid during fever or acidity)

name: Shankh Mudra
benefits: Improves voice clarity, throat thyroid disorders, and stimulates digestion.
steps: Encircle your left thumb with the four fingers of your right hand.
Touch your right thumb to the tip of your left middle finger.
Hold hands near your chest, looking like a conch shell.
Breathe through your nose, focusing on throat.

name: Apana Vayu Mudra
benefits: Strengthens heart muscles, regulates blood pressure, and provides immediate relief from heart attacks.
steps: Fold the index finger down to touch the base of the thumb.
Touch the tips of the middle and ring fingers to the tip of the thumb.
Keep the little finger straight.
Practice on both hands.

name: Mahasirs Mudra
benefits: Relieves sinus congestion, tension headaches, and eye strain.
steps: Touch the tips of your thumb, index, and middle fingers together.
Place your ring finger into the fold at the base of the thumb.
Keep the little finger extended straight.
Breathe calmly and relax your forehead.

name: Mukula Mudra
benefits: Directs healing energy to specific weak organs like liver, spleen, or kidneys.
steps: Bring all four fingertips to touch the tip of the thumb.
This forms a shape like a closed flower bud.
Point this bud towards the body part or organ that needs healing.
Visualize healing green light flowing into that organ.

name: Suchi Mudra
benefits: Clears chronic constipation, releases mental blockages, and detoxifies intestines.
steps: Make a fist with both hands.
Extend your index fingers straight up.
Extend hands outward from the chest.
Hold this gesture while focusing on the lower belly.

name: Surabhi Mudra
benefits: Balances all five elements in the body, cures joint pain, and improves metabolism.
steps: Touch left little finger to right ring finger tip.
Touch right little finger to left ring finger tip.
Touch left middle finger to right index finger tip.
Touch right middle finger to left index finger tip. Keep thumbs apart.

name: Bhudi Mudra
benefits: Regulates fluid balance, prevents dry eyes, and aids kidney/bladder functions.
steps: Touch the tip of the pinky finger to the tip of the thumb.
Keep index, middle, and ring fingers straight.
Sit in a relaxed posture and place your hands on your knees.

name: Granthita Mudra
benefits: Stimulates the thyroid gland, opens throat chakra, and helps vocal clarity.
steps: Interlock your fingers inside your palms.
Touch the tips of your index fingers and thumbs together to form two rings.
Hold the mudra in front of your throat.
Chant 'HAM' or breathe deeply.

name: Prana Mudra
benefits: Boosts immune system, gives instant energy, improves eyesight, and reduces fatigue.
steps: Touch the tips of your ring and little fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep your index and middle fingers extended straight.
Practice with both hands while sitting or walking.

name: Surya Mudra
benefits: Boosts thyroid activity, promotes weight loss, reduces cholesterol, and warms the body.
steps: Fold your ring finger to touch the base of the thumb.
Press the ring finger down gently with your thumb.
Keep other fingers straight.
Do this on an empty stomach.

name: Adi Mudra
benefits: Increases oxygen flow to the brain, expands lung capacity, and calms nervous system.
steps: Place your thumb in the center of your palm.
Wrap your other four fingers over the thumb to make a gentle fist.
Rest the fists on your thighs, facing downwards.
Focus on chest and throat breathing.

name: Uttarabodhi Mudra
benefits: Dispels fear, boosts self-confidence, recharges energy, and stimulates lungs.
steps: Interlock all fingers except index fingers and thumbs.
Extend your index fingers straight up, touching at the tips.
Extend your thumbs straight down, touching at the tips.
Hold hands near your heart.

name: Ksepana Mudra
benefits: Expels negative energy, releases toxins via sweat/breath, and relieves tension.
steps: Clasp fingers together, index fingers extended straight, touching at tips.
Cross your thumbs over each other.
Point index fingers downward toward the floor to release energy.
Hold for a few minutes then rest palms up.

name: Prithvi Mudra
benefits: Overcomes fatigue, promotes weight gain in underweight people, and strengthens body tissues.
steps: Touch the tip of your ring finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep other three fingers straight and relaxed.
Perform this while sitting in Padmasana.

name: Garuda Mudra
benefits: Balances energies, alleviates menstrual cramps, and improves blood circulation.
steps: Place your right hand on top of your left hand, palms facing your chest.
Interlock your thumbs together, forming an eagle wing shape with fingers.
Spread your fingers wide, simulating wings.
Hold in front of your lower abdomen, then move to chest.

name: Vajra Mudra
benefits: Improves low blood pressure, clears dizziness, and stimulates blood circulation.
steps: Point your left index finger straight up.
Encircle the left index finger with the fingers of your right hand.
Touch the tip of the right thumb to the tip of the left index finger.
Hold this near your solar plexus.

name: Makara Mudra
benefits: Activates kidney energy, helps fight fatigue, and clears dark circles under eyes.
steps: Place your right hand inside your left hand.
Slip your right thumb through the pinky and ring finger of your left hand.
Touch the tip of the right thumb to the tip of the left ring finger.
Extend your left thumb upwards.

name: Kurma Mudra
benefits: Grounds active mind, conserves vital energy, and helps quieten thoughts.
steps: Extend fingers, cross right hand over left hand.
Touch the tips of the thumbs to each other.
Curve other fingers inwards to represent a tortoise shell.
Hold in front of the belly.

name: Trishula Mudra
benefits: Boosts inner power, awakens Kundalini energy, and helps self-defense focus.
steps: Fold the little finger to touch the base of the thumb.
Keep index, middle, and ring fingers pointing straight up like a trident.
Hold hands outward near shoulders.
Breathe forcefully.

name: Shivalinga Mudra
benefits: Cures laziness, fills the body with dynamic heat, and stimulates digestive fire.
steps: Make a fist with your right hand, thumb pointing straight up.
Place the right fist on top of your flat left palm.
Hold hands near the chest or upper abdomen.
Practice with deep breathing.

name: Apana Mudra
benefits: Clears constipation, removes body toxins, purifies skin, and helps regular bowel movement.
steps: Touch the tips of your middle and ring fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep index and little fingers straight.
Rest hands on knees with palms facing up.
Focus on the lower abdomen.

name: Samana Mudra
benefits: Improves overall digestion, balances five elements, and regulates metabolism.
steps: Bring the tips of all five fingers together (thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky).
They should touch at one point like a closed flower bud.
Sit relaxed and practice on both hands simultaneously.
Focus on the navel chakra.

name: Pushpaputa Mudra
benefits: Promotes acceptance, openness, and opens up lungs and chest region.
steps: Place your hands on your thighs, palms facing upwards.
Bring hands together so their pinky fingers touch at the sides.
Keep fingers slightly curved as if holding flowers in your palms.
Breathe deeply.

name: Mushti Mudra
benefits: Releases stored anger, irritation, cures constipation, and aids liver digestion.
steps: Fold all your fingers into a fist.
Place your thumb over your ring finger.
Hold this gesture with a firm but comfortable pressure.
Sit quietly and observe your breathing.

name: Matangi Mudra
benefits: Calms excited heart, relieves tension in stomach, liver, and digestive tracts.
steps: Interlock your fingers at the solar plexus level.
Extend your middle fingers straight out, touching at the tips.
Keep all other fingers folded inside.
Breathe into your stomach.

name: Kartari Mukha Mudra
benefits: Stretches hand tendons, helps eye muscles relaxation, and releases neck tension.
steps: Touch the tips of your ring and little finger to the tip of your thumb.
Extend the index and middle fingers straight up like scissors.
Separate index and middle fingers wide apart.
Hold hands near ears or shoulders.

name: Mayura Mudra
benefits: Strengthens wrists, improves skin radiance, and activates solar plexus energy.
steps: Touch the tip of your ring finger to the tip of your thumb.
Fold the index, middle, and little fingers straight up, separate them.
Hold hands pointing outward like a peacock tail.
Practice with closed eyes.

name: Simha Mudra
benefits: Clears throat infections, thyroid problems, cures stuttering, and strengthens facial muscles.
steps: Sit on your heels (Vajrasana), knees spread apart.
Place your palms on your thighs, fingers spread wide apart.
Lean forward, open your mouth, stretch your tongue out towards the chin.
Exhale forcefully with a 'HA' sound, looking at your third eye.

name: Jnana Mudra
benefits: Improves brain power, boosts nervous system health, and clears confusion.
steps: Touch the tip of your index finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep other fingers straight.
Place your hands on your knees, palms facing DOWNWARDS.
Breathe deeply through your chest.

name: Chinmaya Mudra
benefits: Improves breathing in middle lobes of the lungs, calms anxiety, and clears thinking.
steps: Touch the tip of your index finger to the tip of your thumb.
Curl your middle, ring, and little fingers into your palms.
Rest the hands on your knees with palms facing upwards.
Breathe deeply.

name: Vyana Mudra
benefits: Regulates blood pressure (high or low), clears fatigue, and improves blood circulation.
steps: Touch the tips of your index and middle fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep the ring and little fingers straight.
Rest hands on knees, palms facing up.

name: Udana Mudra
benefits: Boosts metabolism, helps thyroid issues, improves speech/singing voice, and stimulates brain.
steps: Touch the tips of index, middle, and ring fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep the little finger straight.
Rest hands on knees.

name: Akash Mudra
benefits: Strengthens bones, cures ear problems, removes negative thoughts, and opens space chakra.
steps: Touch the tip of your middle finger to the tip of your thumb.
Keep index, ring, and little fingers straight.
Practice on both hands, facing upwards.

name: Kartari Mudra
benefits: Boosts focus, coordinates hand eye movement, and stimulates nervous pathways.
steps: Touch thumb to the tips of ring and little finger.
Extend index and middle finger up.
Separate the extended fingers.

name: Shankhini Mudra
benefits: Balances throat chakra, improves speech clarity, and aids vocal power.
steps: Encircle left thumb with right fingers.
Touch left index to right thumb.
Breathe through your throat, humming softly.

name: Hridaya Mudra
benefits: Releases pent up emotions, clears heart blockages, and regulates blood pressure.
steps: Place index finger tip at the base of the thumb.
Touch middle and ring finger tips to the tip of the thumb.
Keep pinky finger straight.

name: Merudanda Mudra
benefits: Relieves back pain, straightens spine posture, and increases lung capacity.
steps: Fold all fingers into palms, pointing thumbs up.
Extend thumbs straight up.
Rest hands on knees, thumbs pointing towards each other.

name: Pankaj Mudra
benefits: Expels feelings of hopelessness, opens heart to love and joy.
steps: Touch palms together at base.
Separate middle fingers, keep pinkies and thumbs touching.
Open fingers wide like a flower.

name: Brahmara Mudra
benefits: Improves immune system, cures allergies, running nose, and sneezing.
steps: Place index finger inside the fold of the thumb.
Touch tip of thumb to the tip of the middle finger.
Keep ring and little finger straight.

name: Shankha Vayu Mudra
benefits: Stimulates intestines, balances throat chakra, and helps digest heavy foods.
steps: Encircle left thumb with right fingers.
Touch right thumb to left index and middle finger tips.
Hold in front of belly.

name: Khechari Hridaya Mudra
benefits: Brings deep state of trance, slows down pulse, and brings inner silence.
steps: Place right hand over left hand on the heart center.
Touch thumbs to index fingers.
Roll your tongue up to touch the soft palate.

name: Agochari Mudra
benefits: Develops deep concentration, activates Muladhara (root) chakra, and stabilizes the mind.
steps: Sit in meditative posture.
Focus your eyes on the tip of your nose.
Breathe slowly, holding the focus.

name: Bhuchari Mudra
benefits: Enters a state of zero thoughts, calms brain activity, and relaxes nervous system.
steps: Hold your right hand in front of your face, looking at your pinky finger.
Slowly lower your hand, but keep your eyes focused on that same empty space.
Observe the empty space in front of you.

name: Tse Mudra
benefits: Banishes sadness, protects against bad luck, and reduces depression.
steps: Place the tip of your thumb at the base of the little finger.
Wrap other four fingers over the thumb to make a fist.
Place hands on thighs, breathing deeply.

name: Kubera Mudra
benefits: Gives confidence, clears sinuses, and helps focus on personal goals.
steps: Touch the tips of your thumb, index, and middle fingers together.
Fold your ring and little finger into the palm.
Formulate your wish or goal in your mind while holding.

name: Matsya Mudra
benefits: Stretches wrist joints, helps ease osteoarthritis pain, and calms breathing.
steps: Place right hand flat on top of the left hand, facing down.
Extend thumbs outward like fish fins.
Hold hands near your solar plexus.

name: Varada Mudra
benefits: Develops compassion, forgiveness, and connects with spiritual sharing.
steps: Extend your left hand downward, palm facing forward.
Point fingers pointing down towards the earth.
Rest the right hand on your thigh or in Gyan Mudra.

name: Rudra Mudra
translation: Gesture of Cosmic Ruler / Solar Plexus
benefits: Regulates blood flow, relieves dizziness, and activates solar plexus chakra.
steps: Touch the tips of your index and ring fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep middle and little fingers straight.

name: Kundalini Mudra
benefits: Balances sexual energy, unifies dualities, and enhances spiritual awakening.
steps: Form a loose fist with both hands.
Extend your left index finger straight up into the bottom of the right fist.
Encircle the left index finger with right fingers.
Touch the tip of the right thumb to the tip of the left index finger.

name: Pushan Mudra
benefits: Aids digestion, increases food assimilation, and clears stomach bloating.
steps: Right Hand: Touch tips of index and middle fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Left Hand: Touch tips of middle and ring fingers to the tip of your thumb.
Keep other fingers straight and rest hands on thighs.

name: Shankhamukhi Mudra
benefits: Cures speech defects, throat hoarseness, and stimulates vocal cords.
steps: Clasp hands so fingers wrap around opposite thumbs.
Touch index fingers to opposite thumbs.
Blow gently through the opening between hands if doing breath practice.

name: Kurmasana Mudra
benefits: Draws sensory inputs inward, shuts out distractions, and helps introversion.
steps: Sit flat on the floor, fold hands in your lap.
Bring thumbs inside the palms and close fingers tightly.
Cross wrists, resting hands on knees.

name: Kilaka Mudra
benefits: Unlocks mental blockage, cures speech problems, and strengthens resolve.
steps: Interlock all fingers tightly.
Press the knuckles together firmly.
Hold the gesture at the chest level, breathing deeply.

name: Bandha Mudra
benefits: Locks energy within the body, prevents leakage of life force, and grounding.
steps: Sit upright, rest hands flat on your knees.
Inhale fully, then press chin tightly down to chest (Jalandhara Bandha).
Keep arms straight and locked at elbows.
